preconditionEvidence: Six Agents were selected with disjoint planned outputs and capacity one.
Five additional chats returned HUMAN-reported WAITING_HUMAN_GO acknowledgements.
Wave 001 and six immutable Jobs were published but not activated.
observations: The exact pinned agent-job claim-policy schema forbids settledRearmStateTemplateRef; Wave-001 Jobs contained it.
Jobs 102-106 target REIDENTIFICATION_REQUIRED Agent States but omit the corresponding immutable reidentification evidence as READ_ONLY Job input.
The Wave-001 aggregate mandate does not satisfy the Agent-specific authority-basis contract.
No direct HUMAN GO was sent after job publication.
No activation evidence, claim, Agent-State mutation or product access occurred.
All six Wave-001 MASTER Job States were transitioned to SUPERSEDED.
verdictReason: The intended six-agent Wave was not safely activatable under the exact pinned rc.6 contract. SAFOR correctly failed closed before any Agent or product effect.
rootCause: The MASTER job-generation path mixed the preselection rearm contract into the claim policy, omitted required reidentification evidence inputs, and reused a wave-level mandate where per-Agent authority was required.
learnedRule: Multi-agent dispatch readiness requires exact schema validation of every immutable Job, Agent-specific authority coverage, and current-State-specific preselection evidence binding before the HUMAN is instructed to send GO.
